subject: world_language
concept: Understanding and using complex sentence structures with multiple subordinate clauses
source_inspiration: adapted from CEFR B2 grammatical range descriptors — original content, not copied text

exercise.pictorial: Student combines simple sentence-piece cards into a single complex sentence with a subordinate clause

misconception_flags: joins two independent clauses without a proper subordinating structure, creating a run-on

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
target_language: configurable — student/parent selects target language at enrollment
